supply_registration: SUPPLY-007 (PREMISE-001/007); human_supply executed by AI with audit layer, pending external audit; explicitly NOT user supply
purpose: A delay-equivalent pair of computations differs only in arrival round. A race against a declared partner collapses the arrival distinction into a value distinction (the earlier arrival wins and keeps its value; otherwise the partner's value is delivered). A downstream process declared in advance completes only when the delivered value carries the original producer's witness. Find whether the declared downstream consumer completes the original activity on every result-equivalent pair after the race truncation.

source_basis.kind: AI-frozen new task family over the pinned existing delay model (GEN-001 supply, not user supply)
references: PREMISE-001/006 shard entry PREMISE-E-02 (propositional truncation: witness not recoverable)
Atria的方案/修订片/003 (GEN-001 nine-field task specification and role discipline)

input.type_ref: ground terms of Delay Bool: omega or ret n b with n <= 3 (declared grammar L1-WITNESS-RECOVERY-v1)
input.available_information: only what the pinned model's constructors and operations expose

environment.arrival_policy: synchronous rounds; a race returns the earlier-arriving branch, left priority on ties
environment.nondeterminism: none inside the fragment (single-thread deterministic delay)
environment.fairness: race is synchronous with left priority on ties, as pinned

observation.trace: round index n is carried by ret but is invisible to delay equivalence
observation.time_structure: discrete synchronous rounds only; no continuity or physical-time claim

completion.criterion_ref: a declared deadline k observes arrival within k rounds; a declared bind continuation models a downstream process that completes on the true branch and diverges on the false branch

allowed_resources: finite enumeration budget; one native kernel check per selected witness plus positive and negative controls
prohibited_extra_information: the downstream consumer may not use information the original task was declared not to hold: no labels, no branch tags, no oracle. The race partner and the downstream continuation are declared consumers of the same original activity and are declared up front.
assumptions: the fragment is the pinned delay model, not general partiality or general propositional truncation

the race models the truncation step only in the sense that it collapses an arrival-round distinction into a value distinction; this is a bounded modelling correspondence, not a claim that Delay Bool is HoTT's propositional truncation
the race partner and the downstream continuation are declared consumers of the same original activity
no physical-time or implementation claim is made
obligations: the verified statement must be a ground instance inside the declared grammar
at least one witness must bind a continuation declared only in L1-WITNESS-RECOVERY-v1, proving the family is outside l1-v0/v1/v2
the separating consumer must be one of the declared consumers, not an oracle added after seeing a candidate
an exploration instance must not be upgraded into a new mathematical claim

known_positive_controls.note: expected separation: left survives the race and binds to a converging value; right loses the race and the downstream diverges. External benchmark only; the search is not given this answer.

known_negative_controls.description: a deadline horizon at or above both round indices cannot separate the pair

correspondence.original_activity: a service whose value is produced by one of two result-equivalent producers; a race against a declared partner is applied, then a downstream process that needs the original producer's witness to complete
theoryization_steps: model each producer as a single-thread deterministic delay
identify computations by delay equivalence, as pinned in the model (this is the truncation step: the arrival round, i.e. which producer won, is forgotten)
compose with the declared consumers (race partner, then the downstream continuation, and optionally a deadline)
correspondence.observation_justification: all consumers are declared in the pinned model; the race reads only the round indices the model already carries, and the downstream continuation is part of the task declaration
preservation_claims: the input domain, the value type and the delivery requirement are unchanged from the task declaration
only the declared consumers are applied; no extra branch information is exposed
open_obligations: the Delay Bool fragment is a bounded correspondent of the E-02 truncation premise, not HoTT's propositional truncation itself; a cubical-native truncation family remains a V2 candidate
a real consumer (E6-style) is out of scope for this bounded acceptance unit
the physical reading of time is not addressed by this fragment
